title: Console Lite: rebaseline insights MVP and define minimal telemetry surface
creator: Aisha Patel
description: PRD follow-up to limit scope for the first public Console Insights MVP. The original PRD requested a broad observability surface (per-route flamegraphs, 90-day retention, per-token cost breakdown, full trace waterfall, and long-tail session search). After engineering and infra capacity review, we are rebaselining to a minimal, testable telemetry surface that meets SLOs and provides immediate value to customers while deferring expensive items to later cycles. This ticket captures the specific scope cuts, acceptance criteria, rollout constraints, and follow-up/backlog items.
tradeoffs: Retention reduced from 90 days -> 7 days for traces/logs to keep storage and indexing costs within current budget (trade-off: limited historical troubleshooting window).
Per-token cost breakdown deferred to v2; MVP will show cost per-route and cost per-model only (trade-off: less granular billing signal, but simpler UI + backend).

Full flamegraph / per-span breakdown deferred; MVP exposes aggregated span timing (P50/P95) and top 5 hotspots by route (trade-off: developers cannot deep dive into individual traces from Console in MVP).
Heatmap/usage-by-hour visualization replaced with a compact sparkline to reduce rendering and query complexity in the initial launch.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard landing card shows P50 and P95 latency, error rate (5xx) and request throughput for selected time window (last 1h, 24h, 7d).
Cost panel surfaces total cost by model and by route for the selected window with absolute and percent delta vs previous window. No per-token or per-session cost in MVP.

Tracing surface: for a selected route, show aggregated span timing histogram and a list of top 5 spans by cumulative time. Individual trace drilldown (full waterfall) returns a message "Detailed traces coming in v2" and links to live Grafana traces where available.
Retention for traces/logs limited to 7 days and enforced by backend; retention configuration UI hidden in MVP.
Role-based access: Console users with role 'viewer' can see dashboards and cost; 'operator' role can view tracing summary. RBAC integration validated end-to-end in staging.
All data queries must complete within 1.2s P95 for the default 24h window on dedicated infra; performance validation run and results uploaded to the release checklist.
Smoke tests cover dashboard load, switching time-window, cost aggregation accuracy (cross-check against billing export), and RBAC enforcement.
